about.title: Finding a home in CDMX shouldn't be this hard.
about.subtitle: Nidō was built for everyone navigating Mexico City's fragmented rental market.
about.story: CDMX has one of Latin America's most vibrant rental markets — but also one of the most fragmented. Listings are scattered across dozens of platforms, mostly in Spanish, with no easy way to compare or consolidate them. We built Nidō to fix that.
about.forExpatsDesc: Relocating to Mexico City is exciting but overwhelming. Nidō removes the language barrier, explains the rental process, and connects you with trustworthy listings.
about.forLocalsDesc: Whether you're moving colonias or relocating from another city, Nidō saves you hours of searching and helps you find the best value in your target neighborhood.
about.forSubletttersDesc: Need to offload your lease? Our marketplace puts your listing in front of thousands of people actively searching for exactly what you have.
about.mission: Make finding a home in Mexico City as easy as it should be — for everyone.
